ai_summary: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd. has allotted 114,941 new equity shares following the exercise of employee stock options and restricted stock units under its ESOP Scheme 2021. This action increases the company's paid-up equity share capital by ₹ 5,74,705, resulting in a negligible dilution of approximately 0.04% for existing shareholders. This is a routine event related to employee incentive programs and presents no material red flags.
